content.user_title: Find App Keyword Opportunities with ASOScan
content.value_statement: App teams need relevant keywords that competitors rank for but their own app misses. This skill ranks ASOScan opportunities and organizes approved tracking actions.
actual_capabilities: Find an app in the connected ASOScan account using tools or the documented API.
Retrieve keyword opportunities with volume, difficulty, opportunity scores, and competitor rankings.
Prioritize relevant keywords and separate quick wins from a watchlist.
Identify gaps where tracked competitors rank and the app has no ranking or a poor ranking.
Optionally research shortlisted terms after approval of the eight-credit cost.
Track approved keywords and report which terms were added or skipped.
limitations: Requires connected ASOScan tools or shell access with a configured ASOSCAN_API_KEY.
Coverage is limited to apps in the account and competitors already tracked there.
Opportunities and tracking each cost two credits; optional research costs eight credits per call.
Tracking requires write access and approval; opportunity scores do not guarantee future rankings.

use_cases.title: Prioritize an app keyword backlog
use_cases.description: Review relevant opportunities and separate achievable targets from terms that need more validation.

use_cases.title: Review competitor keyword gaps
use_cases.description: Compare app and competitor rankings to explain which missing terms deserve attention in a selected country.

use_cases.title: Track approved client keywords
use_cases.description: Present a shortlist for a client app, obtain approval, and report added or skipped tracking terms.

prompt_templates.title: Find initial opportunities
prompt_templates.prompt: Find keyword opportunities for [app] in [country]. Show quick wins and a watchlist. Do not add tracking.

prompt_templates.title: Compare competitor gaps
prompt_templates.prompt: For [app] in [country], prioritize relevant keywords where competitors rank but my app does not. Include volume, difficulty, scores, and competitor ranks.

prompt_templates.title: Validate selected finalists
prompt_templates.prompt: Review opportunities for [app] in [country] and propose three finalists. Explain research costs and wait for approval before validating them.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: manage optional research and credit spending.

prompt_templates.title: Complete an approved tracking workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Review up to 200 opportunities for [app] in [country]. Propose relevant tracking terms, request approval before changes, then report added and skipped terms.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: move from analysis to approved account changes.

output_examples.input: Find opportunities for my habit app in the US without adding tracking.
output: Illustrative output only; these figures are not retrieved account data.
Quick win: daily habit tracker. Volume: 38. Difficulty: 21. Opportunity score: 76. Your app: unranked. Rival A: position 4.
Watchlist: habit planner. Volume: 52. Difficulty: 64. Opportunity score: 59. Higher difficulty needs further assessment.

output_examples.input: After I approve the proposed terms, add them to tracking and summarize the result.
output: Skipped: habit planner. Reason: already tracked.

best_practices: Confirm the app and country before retrieving or tracking keyword opportunities.
Check relevance and competitor rankings alongside opportunity scores and difficulty.
Approve research costs and tracking changes explicitly; keep API credentials out of reports.
anti_patterns: Targeting irrelevant keywords only because their volume or opportunity score is high.
Tracking terms or running higher-cost research without the required approval.
Presenting opportunity scores as guaranteed rankings or inventing missing metrics.

faq.question: What access do I need?
faq.answer: Connect ASOScan tools, or provide shell access with ASOSCAN_API_KEY already configured. Use asoscan-setup when neither option is available.

faq.question: Which AI tools are supported?
faq.answer: The report lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code. Live results still require working ASOScan tools or API access.

faq.question: Which apps and competitors are covered?
faq.answer: ASOScan covers apps in your account and competitors you already track. This workflow does not discover an unrestricted market-wide keyword dataset.

faq.question: How many API credits does the workflow use?
faq.answer: App listing is free. Opportunities and tracking each cost two credits. Optional keyword research costs eight credits and requires approval.

faq.question: Will the skill track keywords automatically?
faq.answer: No. Tracking requires your approval and write access. The workflow reports added terms and skipped terms after the request.

faq.question: Does a high opportunity score guarantee a ranking?
faq.answer: No. Scores guide prioritization. Relevance, difficulty, and competitor rankings still need review before selecting keywords.
